“Record the dates of existence of the en: "Ngolisa li-date tsa boemo ba ntho e hlalosoang. Bakeng sa lik'hamphani kenyaletsa letsatsi la theho/temo/molao o lumellang le ho qetella. \"Record the title and other pertinent d: "Ngola lebitso le lintlha tse ling tsa bohlokoa tsa li-finding aids le litaelo tse phatlalalitsoeng le/kapa tse sa phatlalalisoang tse lokisitsoeng ke setheo le tsa liphatlalatso tse ling tse amehang. Sebelisa ISO 690 Tlhahisoleseling le tlhahisoleseling - Litšupiso tsa bibliographic le melao e 'ngoe ea naha kapa ea machaba ea ho ngola." (ISDIAH 5.3.8)
\"Record the opening hours of the instit: "Ngola lihora tsa ho bula tsa setheo le matsatsi a phomolo a selemo, a selemo le a sechaba, le ho koala ha ho reroa. \"Describe access policies, including an: "Hlalosa mananeo a phihlello, ho kenyeletsa likhetho le/kapa melao-motheo bakeng sa ts'ebeliso ea lisebelisoa le lisebelisoa. Ngola tlhahisoleseling mabapi le ho ngolisa, lipuisano, litikiti tsa baleki, lintlha tsa khotsofalo, litefoea tsa kenello, jj. Moo ho loketseng, etsa tshebediso ea molao-motheo o amehang." (ISDIAH 5.4.2)
\"Record information about travelling to: "Ngola tlhahisoleseling mabapi le ho tsamaea ho setheo le lintlha tsa basebelisi ba nang le litšobotsi, ho kenyeletsa litšobotsi tsa moaho, lisebelisoa kapa lisebelisoa tse ikhethileng, parking kapa li-lift." (ISDIAH 5.4.3)
\"Record information about the onsite se: "Ngola tlhahisoleseling mabapi le litšebeletso tsa sebaka se fanoeng ke setheo joalo ka lipuo tse buuoang ke basebetsi, libaka tsa patlisiso le puisano, litšebeletso tsa potso, libuka tsa kahare, mapu, microfiches, audio-visual, likamore tsa khomphutha, jj. Ngola hape tlhahisoleseling e amehang mabapi le litšebeletso tsa patlisiso, joalo ka patlisiso e etsoang ke setheo, le theko e lefelloang haeba ho sebetsa." (ISDIAH 5.5.1)
\"Record information about reproduction: "Ngola tlhahisoleseling mabapi le litšebeletso tsa phetiso tse fumanehang ho sechaba (microfilms, photocopies, lifoto, likopi tse digitized). \"Record information about spaces availa: "Ngola tlhahisoleseling mabapi le libaka tse fumanehang bakeng sa ts'ebeliso ea sechaba (lipaleho tsa nako e telele kapa tsa nakana, khokahano ea inthanete e mahala kapa e lefelloang, li-cash machine, li-cafeteria, li-resto, li-shop, jj)." (ISDIAH 5.5.3)
\"Record a unique description identifier: "Ngola sehlaloso se ikhethileng sa tlhaloso ho latela likamano tsa lehae le/kapa tsa naha. \"Record the full authorised form of nam: "Ngolisa sebopeho se lumelletsoeng ka botlalo sa lebitso kapa mabitso a setheo se amehang ho theha, ho fetola kapa ho phatlalatsa tlhaloso, kapa, ka mokhoa o mong, ngolisa khoutu ea setheo ho latela maemo a khoutu ea setheo sa naha kapa sa machaba."
